q1_issues.issue: "pouches of salt-bloom" is fused into a coined compound kind salt_bloom_pouch (with its genus chain), naming a kind the surface never states and dropping the containment relation between the pouches and the salt-bloom.
"that afternoon" is propagated onto the deciding event only; the adjunct more plausibly times the complement (the beginning of the salt-bloom additions), so the attachment site may be wrong.

"in the ledger" is encoded as Location, asserting a spatial location for the recording event, where the document/medium reading matches the prompt's "in a statement" case and its preposition-named In oblique.

q2_gaps: container / quantity of-phrase ("pouches of salt-bloom") - Possessive/genitive NP explicitly excludes a measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") but supplies no positive encoding for one

agent-nominalization taking an of-phrase argument ("the keepers of the Cliff Path") - Complements of nouns and adjectives rules on act/result/quality nominalizations and on relational nouns with no underlying verb, leaving an -er agent noun with a live underlying verb unruled between Of and Possession
notes: "the Council" is correctly treated as a capitalized common noun (no Name atom) and as a singular collective that does not distribute; the control-verb complement sk_begin_1 correctly carries no tense. The genus atoms (Inheritance cold_snap snap) and (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) rest on IS-A judgments that are not checkable for these invented terms.
